best_for: Students, analysts and researchers on Windows or Mac who need the R language itself for statistics and graphics, before adding the editor and packages they work in.

points.title: The engine, not a full workbench
points.text: This download gives you the R language and a basic console. On the Mac, R.app adds a simple GUI. Most day-to-day work happens in packages and editors you add on top.

points.title: Free under the GPL
points.text: R is free software under GPL-2.0 or later, published by the R Core Team through CRAN mirrors, with manuals and FAQs on CRAN.

points.title: Windows: 64-bit only
points.text: The current Windows build is 64-bit only and needs Microsoft's Universal C Runtime. Windows 10 and Server 2016 or later already have it; older systems must install it first. The installer listed here installs for all users.

points.title: Two Mac builds, two floors
points.text: The Apple silicon package needs macOS 14 Sonoma or later. The Intel package runs on macOS 11 Big Sur or later. Older Macs can use archived builds, such as R 4.2.3 for macOS 10.13 on Intel.

points.title: Extras for graphics and compiling
points.text: On the Mac, X11 graphics and tcltk need XQuartz 2.8.5 or later, and packages with Fortran code may need GNU Fortran from the R for Mac tools page. Reinstall XQuartz after a major macOS upgrade.

points.title: Versions kept here
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 26 versions. macOS lists only 4.6.2, so older Mac releases come from the CRAN archive. This site has no Linux listing for R.
